Assistant Professor, Department of Architecture: Bachelor’s degree in Architecture or equivalent and M. Arch/M. Plan, 55% marks at Master’s and two preceding exams, one year relevant professional experience. Assistant Professor, Department of Yoga: Master’s Degree in Yoga/Yoga Therapy/Yogic Science, 55% in Master and 60% in preceding exams, NET in Yoga or Ph.D. exemption as per UGC Regulations 2018. Specialization: Yoga therapy /Yogic Science.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced by CURAJ?
faq.answer: Central University of Rajasthan has announced a total of 8 vacancies for the post of Assistant Professor.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for CURAJ Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 60000/- Per Month.

faq.question: Q4. What are the minimum educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification generally includes a Master's Degree as per the department's requirement, along with Ph.D. or NET as applicable. Specific qualifications vary by department.

faq.question: Q5. When will the walk-in interviews be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews are scheduled for 01 September 2026 and 02 September 2026, depending on the department.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Central University of Rajasthan, Kishangarh, Rajasthan - 305817.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The job type for these Assistant Professor positions is contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, labeled as 'Official Notification PDF'.
